data.name: Mastar
data.gender_notes: Mastar is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has control, a master, a leader, a commander. The name Mastar carries the meaning “Master, Leader” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Mastar usually hope their child will grow to embody master, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual master, a guru, a guide.
data.etymology: Mastar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Master, Leader.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mastar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mastar" in Hindu culture represents someone who holds authority and control in their domain. It denotes power, strength, and leadership, which are highly respected qualities in any society. The name also carries the connotation of one who commands and leads, implying the ability to inspire and guide others towards achieving their goals.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Mastar" can be seen as a reminder of the inner master or guru within each individual. It encourages the person to tap into their inner wisdom and leadership abilities, acknowledging their potential to guide themselves and others towards spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name serves as a constant reminder to be the master of one's own thoughts, emotions, and actions, and to use this inner power to serve a higher purpose. By recognizing the divine guru within and embodying the qualities of a "Mastar," one can cultivate a strong and grounded sense of self-worth and spiritual authority.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mastar: The radiant one, illuminating the path with unwavering determination and passion. Embodying the spirit of devotion and courage, Mastar shines as a beacon of hope and inspiration.
